Play native per-hero A sound at launch; skip repeating that firing sound at the marked strike contact; leave native skill sound routes intact. Actual audibility is unverified.
Manual/semi S: actual displacement >=1 enables one 8% focused A volley within 1.3s from a valid ranged firing lane. No S cooldown/resource/invulnerability change.
Semi-auto retains a selected valid target and reacquires only when it becomes invalid or out of range.
Ordinary critical A keeps compact flash, zero hitstop and zero screen shake; explicit heavy/charged attacks and defeats retain bounded feedback; Persona feedback shape is preserved.
An ally D contact cannot grant the host a countershot; native resonance meter rules retain ownership.
Three sequential wave-3/4 interlude actors remain native; exclude protected/objective/ally templates; invalidate stale alive transient actor references after same-world restore.
